new_scope.name: Schreier-Hecke stochastic-fiber lifts
new_scope.general_transfer: For a d-regular Cayley cutoff base and a fixed finite uniform fiber, arbitrary symmetric doubly-stochastic k-regular cross kernels K_s plus an r-regular refresh kernel of gap eta give d_G(at)<=d_H(t)<=d_G(at)+0.5*sqrt(m-1)*exp(-b*eta*t), a=kd/(kd+r), b=r/(kd+r), and gap(H)>=min(a gap(G), b eta). Cross kernels need not be permutations, normalizers, commuting, or individually gapped.
new_scope.explicit_class: Degree-18 vertex-transitive Schreier-fiber lifts of degree-6 Kaufman-Lubotzky Ramanujan Cayley graphs using S4/<(12)> orbital kernels.
new_scope.not_LRE: At r=floor((1/2)log_17 N), ball/tree-benchmark ratio is <=N^{-beta+o(1)}, beta=(1/2)(1-log(5)/log(17))=0.2159695164...>0.

mechanism_advance.removed_obstruction: The prior algebraic transfers needed hidden kicks to be translations/isometries, or switched hidden kernels to have a common positive gap. The new pathwise argument allows singular noncommuting stochastic averaging kicks: doubly stochastic kernels are L2 contractions, while all strict contraction is supplied by a separate refresh semigroup.
mechanism_advance.exact_certificate: On S4/<(12)>, K_A has eigenvalue 1 with multiplicity 4 (zero one-sided gap), refresh R has gap 2/3, and ||[K_A,R]||_{2->2}=sqrt(2)/3.
mechanism_advance.general_conjecture_reduction: Every finite vertex-transitive graph X=A/H is exactly the right-coset projection of an H-bi-invariant random walk on a transitive automorphism group A, started from uniform H. The lift preserves TV, every f-divergence, and the full information-variable law exactly. Thus absence of an algebraic group/factor representation is not an obstruction; the remaining obstacle is controlling a possibly large nonnormal stabilizer/Hecke algebra without a separated refresh direction.

partner_complement: Latest P26 read: 2026-09-20_15-59-31__partitioned-green-clique-insertion-transfer.md. P26 owns quotient-conditioned Green/shell/radial transfer; this run is homogeneous-space/Hecke algebra and pathwise stochastic-fiber contraction.
preserved_failures: Global point-mass L2 on an undivided growing hidden state can pay a fatal sqrt(cardinality) factor.
Normal-quotient/translation voltage structure is not available in arbitrary transitive graphs.
A common positive gap for every cross/switched kernel is too strong; the explicit K_A here has gap zero.
residual_obstruction: For the canonical Hecke lift of a general vertex-transitive spectral expander, the stabilizer H may be large and nonnormal and the Hecke convolution may have no bounded residual refresh component. Need a transitivity-supplied decomposition or direct varentropy/representation estimate for the H-bi-invariant walk.
next_attack: Decompose the canonical H-bi-invariant transition in the permutation representation Ind_H^A(1); seek a bounded-rank or energy-refresh component forced by the graph spectral gap, or prove a direct information-varentropy bound for subgroup-uniform starts using matrix coefficients of the Hecke algebra.
